notes: Account Number,Transaction Date,Transaction Amount,Transaction Type,Transaction Description,Balance. The amount has no sign: Transaction Type says Debit (money out) or Credit (money in). Dates MM/DD/YY, newest first, running Balance, no quoting or thousands separator, LF assumed. Column order as reported in 2021 (another report puts Transaction Description second). Opening is the oldest balance less its amount; closing the newest balance.
